items.descriptionAdvanced: Lake Ichkeul and its surrounding wetlands form a vital ecological landmark in northern Tunisia, recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage site. Dedicated birdwatching posts allow researchers and tourists to observe migratory behaviors without disturbing the wildlife. As a focal point for North African ornithological study, it remains an indispensable site for global biodiversity monitoring.
